name: graph_war
description: A headless, faithful reimplementation of the artillery game **Graphwar**, in which a shot's trajectory is the graph of a function `y = f(x)` typed by the player. The goal is to reproduce the behavior of the original Java client (`ref/graphwar/`, GPL-licensed) closely enough to (a) run reproducible games and (b) later plug in LLM agents and evaluate them.
